verdict.rationale: Jan exposes a local OpenAI-compatible API under a /v1 path, but its docs describe that prefix as a user-changeable compatibility convention borrowed from OpenAI, not as API versioning. No versioning or deprecation policy is documented. The /v1 prefix is an adjacent convention rather than the story's capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
